issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL4-CONTAIN-1 binding hints owner InMotion target Accelerating; exact_source_inventory.states for InMotion and Accelerating both have parent null; inspection_equivalent_facts.states parent for both is llms_emp_feedback_final_0034.
issues.expected: InMotion contains substate Accelerating as a direct child.
issues.observed: Exact source inventory lists InMotion parent null and Accelerating parent null; FCSTM model shows both as top-level states with no containment hierarchy and a direct transition InMotion -> Accelerating transition:line:32.
issues.reason: NL4 requires containment and source inventory and closed model show flat state ownership, so the required containment is absent.
issues.requirement_quote: Within the InMotion state, the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching, which represent different phases of the train's motion.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: PlantUML shows InMotion --> Accelerating transition, which could be read as an operational relation but does not establish composite containment.
issues.title: InMotion missing containment of Accelerating substate

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL4-CONTAIN-2 binding hints owner InMotion target Cruising; exact_source_inventory.states parent null for both; inspection_equivalent_facts.states parent llms_emp_feedback_final_0034.
issues.expected: InMotion contains substate Cruising as a direct child.
issues.observed: Exact source inventory lists InMotion parent null and Cruising parent null; FCSTM model shows both as top-level states with transitions InMotion -> Cruising transition:line:35.
issues.reason: NL requires containment and the author source and closed model inventory show no parent-child relationship.
issues.requirement_quote: Within the InMotion state, the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching, which represent different phases of the train's motion.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Transition InMotion -> Cruising exists, suggesting operational reachability but not structural containment.
issues.title: InMotion missing containment of Cruising substate

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL4-CONTAIN-3 binding hints owner InMotion target Approaching; exact_source_inventory.states parent null; inspection_equivalent_facts.states parent llms_emp_feedback_final_0034.
issues.expected: InMotion contains substate Approaching as a direct child.
issues.observed: Exact source inventory lists InMotion parent null and Approaching parent null; FCSTM model shows both as top-level states with transitions InMotion -> Approaching transition:line:37.
issues.reason: Containment obligation is not realized in source or closed model.
issues.requirement_quote: Within the InMotion state, the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching, which represent different phases of the train's motion.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Direct transition InMotion -> Approaching exists, indicating operational coupling but not composite containment.
issues.title: InMotion missing containment of Approaching substate

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL5-INIT-1 binding hints owner InMotion target Accelerating; inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions show no initial-entry transition owned by InMotion; verify_facts initial-entry check only proves root [*] -> DoorsClosing.
issues.expected: InMotion owner has an initial pseudostate edge targeting Accelerating.
issues.observed: FCSTM shows InMotion -> Accelerating transition:line:32 with no trigger, and also InMotion -> Cruising transition:line:35 and InMotion -> Approaching transition:line:37; no owner-local initial entry edge for InMotion exists.
issues.reason: The required owner-local initial entry is absent; the model uses flat transitions instead of composite entry semantics.
issues.requirement_quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate, moving to the Cruising substate once cruising speed is reached, as indicated by the "Reached Cruising/Cruise" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Untriggered transition InMotion -> Accelerating exists, which could be misread as a default entry but is a normal transition, not an initial pseudostate edge.
issues.title: InMotion missing default entry into Accelerating

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL3-EFFECT-1 binding hints state EmergencyStopping effect sends Obstacle Detected signal; inspection_equivalent_facts.event_consumers show Obstacle_Detected consumed on InMotion -> EmergencyStopping transition:line:30; no event emission from EmergencyStopping.
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping state has an effect that sends Obstacle Detected signal.
issues.observed: FCSTM EmergencyStopping has enter abstract EmergencyStop and outgoing transition on Obstacle_Cleared to [*]; no effect emission of Obstacle Detected is recorded.
issues.reason: The required send effect is not present in the closed model; the signal is a trigger for entry, not an effect of the state.
issues.requirement_quote: When an obstacle is detected, the system enters the EmergencyStopping state, which includes the actions "Emergency Stop" and sends the "Obstacle Detected" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Incoming transition to EmergencyStopping is triggered by Obstacle_Detected, which could be interpreted as the signal being involved, but the NL requires the state itself to send the signal.
issues.title: EmergencyStopping effect mismatch, Obstacle Detected signal not sent

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL9-EFFECT-1 binding hints state Approaching effect sends Send signal; inspection_equivalent_facts.event_consumers for Approaching list Ready_to_Stop and Destination_Missed only.
issues.expected: Approaching state sends Send signal as an effect.
issues.observed: FCSTM Approaching has enter abstract Decelerate and outgoing transitions on Ready_to_Stop and Destination_Missed; no Send signal emission is recorded.
issues.reason: The required effect is not present in the closed model inventory.
issues.requirement_quote: In the Approaching substate, the system sends the "Send" signal and continues to approach the destination.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Approaching is reachable and has outgoing behavior, which could be read as continued approach, but no Send effect is documented.
issues.title: Approaching missing Send signal effect

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL8-ACTION-1 binding hints state Accelerating action Entry/Accelerate; fcstm_model text shows state Accelerating { enter abstract Accelerate; }.

issues.requirement_quote: The system enters the Accelerating substate when motion begins, marked by the "Entry/Accelerate" action.
